name: Save Restricted Content Bot v4
description: Save Restricted Content Bot: Instagram, Youtube, Tiktok, Twitch and etc downloader

OWNER_ID.description: User ID(s) to be set as bot owner(s), separated by space (e.g., 1234 5678)

STRING.description: Optional session string for logged-in user sessions

FORCE_SUB.description: Channel ID (with -100 prefix) for forced subscription

LOG_GROUP.description: Log channel/group ID (with -100 prefix) where the bot will send logs

MASTER_KEY.description: Master key used for session encryption

YT_COOKIES.description: Cookies for YouTube downloads (in Netscape format)

INSTA_COOKIES.description: Cookies for Instagram downloads (in Netscape format)

FREEMIUM_LIMIT.description: Limit for freemium users (in MB or desired unit)

PREMIUM_LIMIT.description: Limit for premium users (in MB or desired unit)

JOIN_LINK.description: type join channel link which comes on /start
